body_lead: Maharashtra announces AI policy, envisages Rs 10,000 crore investment The government proposes to establish six AI Excellence Centres and five AI Innovation Cities under the policy, said an official statement Listen to This Article The Maharashtra cabinet on Wednesday approved the Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026 which envisages an investment of ₹10,000 crore in the sector and creation of 1.5 lakh employment opportunities. The government proposes to establish six AI Excellence Centres and five AI Innovation Cities under the policy, said an official statement.
